genes.name: Familial idiopathic pulmonary fibrosis
genes.role: Inherited telomerase defects (about 15% of familial cases) shorten telomeres, so alveolar epithelial cells die and cannot regenerate

genes.name: Idiopathic pulmonary fibrosis
genes.role: Mucin gene variant that raises mucus secretion and alters mucociliary clearance; present in about one third of cases

genes.name: Familial idiopathic pulmonary fibrosis
genes.role: Mutated surfactant drives alveolar epithelial apoptosis and impaired repair; a rare familial form

genes.name: Pulmonary Langerhans cell histiocytosis
genes.role: Found in some young smokers with grooved CD1a-positive cells and Birbeck granules; symptoms usually fade after quitting

genes.name: Pulmonary alveolar proteinosis (hereditary)
genes.role: Macrophages need GM-CSF signaling to clear surfactant; 90% of cases are instead autoimmune, with antibodies against GM-CSF
